metadata.description: Vendor-neutral cloud architecture design for Claude Code.

plugins.name: cloud-architect
plugins.description: Cloud architecture sized to what your team can run, with data residency built in: options mapped to AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes or EU sovereign providers (Hetzner, OVHcloud, Scaleway, STACKIT, IONOS), team-fit scoring, diagrams, ADRs with fitness criteria and a CTO decision brief. Covers new systems, features in existing code and migrations. Reads code, never writes it.
